claim: Patchline ships an escalation policy that abstains and requests review under bounded uncertainty. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the abstains claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make abstention-escalation-policy-gate`.
